description: This Java interface defines the ProgramWorkflowService in the OpenMRS API, managing operations related to programs, workflows, states, patient programs, concept state conversions, and related entities. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and querying various program-related objects and their UUIDs, along with user privilege annotations.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowService
classes.description: The interface defining service methods for managing programs, workflows, states, patient programs, and concept state conversions within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setProgramWorkflowDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO responsible for database operations related to ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Saves a Program object to the database, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its primary key (ID).

methods.name: getProgramByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Program using its exact name.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns all programs including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getPrograms
methods.description: Finds programs matching a name fragment.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Deletes a program from the database.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Deletes a program from the database, optionally cascading related data.

methods.name: retireProgram
methods.description: Marks a program as retired with a given reason.

methods.name: unretireProgram
methods.description: Reverses the retired status of a program.

methods.name: getProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its UUID.

methods.name: getPatientStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientState by UUID.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Saves a PatientProgram to the database.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by its ID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Finds PatientPrograms matching various criteria.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram without cascade.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram with optional cascade.

methods.name: voidPatientProgram
methods.description: Voids a PatientProgram with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidPatientProgram
methods.description: Reverses the void status of a PatientProgram.

methods.name: getPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Returns possible outcome concepts for a program.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by UUID.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves a ConceptStateConversion.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by ID.

methods.name: getAllConceptStateConversions
methods.description: Lists all ConceptStateConversions.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion with cascade options.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Finds a ConceptStateConversion by ProgramWorkflow and Concept.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by ID.

methods.name: getStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves PatientPrograms matching cohort and/or program filters.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Lists programs that use a particular concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Lists program workflows that use a particular concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Lists program workflow states that use a particular concept.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by UUID.
